data.one_liner: Native Dart client to run GROQ queries and fetch documents from Sanity.io.
data.what_it_does: Allows Dart and Flutter applications to connect to Sanity.io projects, execute GROQ queries, fetch live data streams, and build asset URLs with transformations. It provides type-safe interactions with Sanity's HTTP API.
use_when: You are building a Flutter or Dart app powered by Sanity.io CMS
You need to execute GROQ queries with parameter support
You require live updates or streaming content from Sanity datasets
avoid_when: You are using a backend other than Sanity.io
You do not use GROQ queries
strengths: Full GROQ query support with type safety
Live fetch capability with automatic reconnects
Flexible asset and image URL handling
weaknesses: Tied specifically to the Sanity.io backend
Limited to supported features of the Sanity HTTP API
